scope: Scanner gallery to candidate confirmation and server-owned preview over real HTTP routes and an isolated SQLite database

environment.browser: Playwright CLI 0.1.24 with Playwright 1.65.1 and preinstalled Chromium
environment.browser_plugin: Unavailable; used the documented Playwright CLI path
environment.backend: Real Flask routes in a dedicated test subprocess
environment.database: SQLite file in a unique system temp directory; removed after inspection
environment.authentication: AUTH_REQUIRED=true with a test-only token verifier and a seeded SQLite user
provider_fakes: Vision model function returned a fixed high-confidence apple fixture
Local lookup was forced to no_local_mapping to exercise the candidate path
FDC Search returned one fixed candidate
FDC Detail returned the existing validated apple fixture
A test-only reviewed source policy was seeded in the isolated database
environment.api_interception: No Playwright route mocks for /predict/vision-food or /nutrition/fdc/*; requests reached the local Flask server

flow.image_input: Synthetic 1x1 PNG selected through the real browser gallery file chooser
flow.vision_response: One apple at confidence 0.95, server-estimated weight 150g; model call was replaced in the backend test process

candidate_search.result: One FDC candidate returned and persisted in SQLite

browser_console_warnings: Existing React Native Web warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated.

issue_found_and_fixed: When vision returned only a high-confidence recognized food with no local nutrition match, detections was empty and the scanner discarded its server scan reference before candidate search. The scanner now preserves the reference for clean server-owned unmatched items, continues to candidate review, and shows a pending-nutrition empty state. Low-confidence and validation-invalid detections remain ineligible.
not_tested: Physical camera capture and a real food photograph
Live Gemini, USDA FDC, Tavily, or other external providers
Production source-rights admission or automatic source registry
Expiry recovery after scan/confirmation TTL; an earlier deliberately slow manual pass correctly expired and returned 409
